title: SRE, Platform & DevOps opportunities
lede: Default six-keyword rotation against myprocom-portal.procomservices.com. Scores measure technical and domain fit only.
latest_update: Re-run September 21, 2026 — no eligible target-family postings; inventory still skews heavily toward Salesforce, AI/ML, embedded, and data-center hardware roles. The prior run's one genuinely target-family posting (Senior Systems Engineer, Cloud & Infrastructure, Toronto) is no longer live.

rows.title: Senior Salesforce DevOps Engineer – AI Automation
rows.gap: Real CI/CD, automation, and delivery-velocity center of gravity (though Salesforce-ecosystem-specific) — appeared in 3 of the 4 keyword searches that returned results. Already known in applications.md (found 2026-08-25, score 6, Procom board) and Skipped there 2026-09-19 (auto-marked expired at that review). Still live on Procom as of this run.

rows.title: Salesforce Integration Architect
rows.gap: Salesforce integration architecture and platform ownership specifically (VMS integration patterns, endpoint/data-flow design) — real infrastructure and reliability language throughout, but the actual deliverable is Salesforce-ecosystem architecture, not general SRE/Platform/DevOps.

rows.title: QA Automation Engineer
rows.gap: QA/test-automation engineering (functional, regression, performance testing, Robot Framework/JMeter) integrated with CI/CD pipelines — quality engineering, not infrastructure/platform/reliability engineering.

rows.title: Data Center Field Service Engineer (Transformer-Specific)
rows.location: Raleigh, North Carolina, US · Remote with on-site travel
rows.gap: Physical field-service work — transformer hardware installation, relay testing, firmware upgrades for utility/data-center electrical infrastructure. Hands-on hardware/electrical engineering, not IT/software platform engineering.

notes_sections.heading: Run notes
items: DevOps Engineer (3 results), Platform Engineer (11 results, 8 reviewed), Site Reliability Engineer (2 results), and Cloud Engineer (12 results, 8 reviewed) all returned candidates; DevSecOps Engineer and Forward Deployed Engineer both returned zero results outright ("We're unable to find any jobs matching your search").

Platform Engineer and Cloud Engineer searches exceeded the 8-result review cap (11 and 12 total respectively) — the unreviewed remainder were screened by title alone (Principal Data Architect duplicate window items, additional embedded/data/network titles) and were not plausibly SRE/Platform/DevOps given the pattern already established across the 8 opened.

Browser-driven throughout, per the skill's requirement — the public marketing site dead-ends, but the real contractor portal (myprocom-portal.procomservices.com) loaded cleanly with no login needed. Confirmed the documented naive-text-extraction trap (only the first visible card's full content renders) and used screenshots plus the find tool to read each card and detail pane instead.
The prior run's one target-family posting, Senior Systems Engineer (Cloud & Infrastructure) in Toronto, did not reappear in any of this run's searches — likely expired/rotated out of inventory.

This run's browser session ran concurrently with two other agents (WWR, Braintrust) sharing the same Chrome tab group — worked around by opening a dedicated tab rather than reusing the shared one, after an initial text-extraction call returned WWR content from a tab another agent had navigated.
No CAPTCHA, verification prompt, or write-side action occurred.
